en_title: The Batman Part 2 Goes in 'Another Totally Different Direction,' Robert Pattinson Teases
cn_title: 帕丁森：《新蝙蝠侠2》将彻底转向
subtitle: 激进改写
opus_summary: 帕丁森透露，《新蝙蝠侠2》将朝截然不同的方向发展，马特·里维斯为影片写出了颇为激进的剧本。影片定于2028年2月18日上映，帕丁森称40多岁后拍打戏更吃力。

paragraphs.en: Robert Pattinson has suggested The Batman Part 2 will be a very different take on the DC superhero than we’ve seen before.
paragraphs.cn: 罗伯特·帕丁森暗示，相比此前的作品，《新蝙蝠侠2》对这位DC超级英雄的诠释将截然不同。

paragraphs.en: Pattinson is set to reprise his role as the Caped Crusader in The Batman Part 2, which has a February 18, 2028 release date. Assuming it hits that date, Part 2 will arrive in theaters just shy of six years after The Batman came out.
paragraphs.cn: 帕丁森将回归出演披风斗士，在《新蝙蝠侠2》中再次饰演蝙蝠侠。影片定于2028年2月18日上映。如果能够如期上映，《新蝙蝠侠2》距离《新蝙蝠侠》上映将不足六年。

paragraphs.en: The movie is largely shrouded in mystery, but Pattinson has started to tease what to expect from it now he’s out and about promoting his new movie, Primetime. And in an interview captured by MYmovies on TikTok , Pattinson teased something quite different than what’s gone before.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，影片的大部分细节仍笼罩在迷雾中。不过，帕丁森正在公开为新片《Primetime》宣传，也开始透露《新蝙蝠侠2》的看点。MYmovies在TikTok上发布了一段采访视频，帕丁森在采访中暗示，新片将与此前的作品大不相同。

paragraphs.en: “Matt just wrote this amazing script,” Pattinson said of The Batman co-writer and director Matt Reeves. “I think the first one was… it’s difficult to reinvent Batman as this new thing. And then to go in another totally different direction. I’m just looking at the playback on certain things… it looks different to the first one.
paragraphs.cn: 「马特刚写出了一份惊人的剧本。」帕丁森在谈及《新蝙蝠侠》的联合编剧兼导演马特·里维斯时说道。「我觉得第一部……要把蝙蝠侠重新诠释成全新的形象，实在很难。接下来还要走向另一个截然不同的方向。我现在只是在看某些片段的回放……它看起来和第一部不一样。」

paragraphs.en: “It’s just amazing. It’s a quite radical change of the script. It’s cool that Warner’s behind it, and DC. It’s just crazy. It’s a really radical retelling of Batman. I think people are going to be excited by it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「这确实很棒。这次剧本改动相当激进。华纳和DC都支持这次改动，这很酷，简直疯狂。这是对蝙蝠侠的一次非常激进的重新诠释。我觉得观众会为此兴奋。」

paragraphs.en: So, what does this mean, exactly? It’s hard to tell. The Batman is a dark and gritty detective story that features a broody Bruce Wayne who struggles to stop the machinations of the Riddler. You’d imagine that Pattinson’s Batman won’t deviate too much from the version of the character we saw back in 2022, but based on what the actor’s saying here, it’s hard to predict. In truth, Pattinson is being almost comically vague about The Batman 2. Is it a courtroom drama? A psychological horror movie? A musical? Well, after Joker: Folie à Deux bombed at the box office, I doubt it’s a musical.
paragraphs.cn: 所以，这到底意味着什么？很难说。《新蝙蝠侠》是一部黑暗且粗粝的侦探故事，讲述阴郁的布鲁斯·韦恩努力阻止谜语人的阴谋。按理说，帕丁森饰演的蝙蝠侠应该不会偏离我们在2022年看到的那个版本太远，但从这位演员的说法来看，影片走向仍然难以预测。说实话，帕丁森谈起《新蝙蝠侠2》时几乎含糊得有些滑稽。它难道是一部法庭剧？心理恐怖片？音乐剧？考虑到《小丑2：双重妄想》在票房上惨败，我不太相信它会是音乐剧。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps The Batman 2 doubles down on the thriller aspect of its predecessor. Maybe it revolves more around its main villain, who has yet to be confirmed, than Batman. It’s unclear if Marvel star Sebastian Stan plays Harvey Dent / Two-Face , as expected, but even if he is, we’re not sure if he’s the main villain.
paragraphs.cn: 或许《新蝙蝠侠2》会进一步强化前作的惊悚元素。影片也可能不再主要围绕蝙蝠侠，而是更多聚焦于尚未确认身份的主要反派。目前尚不清楚漫威演员塞巴斯蒂安·斯坦是否会如外界预期出演哈维·登特／双面人，即使这一点属实，我们也不确定他是否会是主要反派。

paragraphs.en: What we know for sure is Pattinson is finding the fight scenes in The Batman Part 2 harder than those in The Batman , now he’s in his 40s. “I’m definitely feeling my age when fighting a lot," Pattinson told GQ . "I’m literally like, ‘Goddamn, this is significantly harder than it used to be.’ But it’s really fun. And I think the movie’s going to be pretty great. It’s got a really, really fun cast, but it’s a marathon.”
paragraphs.cn: 可以确定的是，帕丁森如今已步入40多岁，觉得《新蝙蝠侠2》的打斗戏比《新蝙蝠侠》中的更难拍。「拍很多打戏时，我确实能感觉到自己的年龄。」帕丁森告诉GQ。「我真的会想：‘该死，这比过去难得多了。’但这非常有意思。我觉得这部电影应该会相当出色。演员阵容真的非常、非常有意思，不过这是一场马拉松。」

paragraphs.en: It's worth remembering that Matt Reeves' The Batman movies are not a part of the ongoing DC Universe, so they're not set in the same universe as Superman, Supergirl, Lanterns, and next year's Man of Tomorrow. Reeves' The Batman and HBO spinoff show The Penguin are part of what is called The Batman Epic Crime Saga . James Gunn’s rebooted DCU will eventually see a fresh actor play Batman when The Brave and the Bold kicks into gear.
paragraphs.cn: 值得注意的是，马特·里维斯执导的《新蝙蝠侠》系列电影并不属于现行DC宇宙，因此与《超人》、《超级少女》、《Lanterns》以及明年的《Man of Tomorrow》不在同一宇宙。里维斯的《新蝙蝠侠》和HBO衍生剧《企鹅人》属于所谓的《The Batman Epic Crime Saga》。等《The Brave and the Bold》启动后，詹姆斯·古恩重启的DCU最终将由一位新演员饰演蝙蝠侠。

paragraphs.en: Speaking of The Penguin, actor Colin Farrell has said he will reprise his role as the crime boss in The Batman Part 2, although in just two scenes . Speaking to ScreenRant in June, Farrell described the script, and his involvement in the movie.
paragraphs.cn: 说到《企鹅人》，科林·法瑞尔表示，他会在《新蝙蝠侠2》中回归饰演那位犯罪头目，不过只会出现在两场戏里。法瑞尔在6月接受ScreenRant采访时，谈到了剧本以及自己参与这部电影的情况。

paragraphs.en: "I got to read from the first to last page and it's really magnificent,” he said. “I just think Matt Reeves is brilliant and he wrote, not only tonally, a really kind of dark and at times terrifying piece, and not only psychologically weighty and nuanced, but really feeling. It's a really... There's moments in it. It's full of feeling. I just think he wrote kind of a contemporary genre masterpiece, really. I'm only in two scenes, which is great because it means I can enjoy the rest of the film."
paragraphs.cn: 「我得以把剧本从第一页读到最后一页，真的精彩绝伦。」他说道。「我觉得马特·里维斯非常出色。他写出的作品不只是在基调上相当黑暗、时而令人恐惧，也不仅在心理层面厚重而细腻，更是充满真情实感。真的……里面有一些时刻，整部作品都充满情感。我觉得，这算是一部当代类型片杰作。我只出演其中两场戏，这很棒，因为这样我就能好好享受影片剩下的部分。」

paragraphs.en: Following a series of online teases , we recently compiled a list of everyone starring in the film, along with their roles as best we know.
paragraphs.cn: 在一系列线上预告之后，我们最近整理了影片的全体演员名单，以及目前所知的他们各自饰演的角色。
